Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (3g), Sodium
Ingredients Required: All-purpose flour, Warm water, Chopped scallions (green onions), Sesame oil, Vegetable oil, Chinese five-spice powder, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead flour with warm water into a soft dough and let rest for 30 minutes. 2. Roll dough thin, brush with sesame oil, sprinkle five-spice powder, salt, and generous scallions. 3. Roll into a tight log, coil into a spiral, flatten again, and pan-fry in oil until golden and crispy layered.

Dish Name: Jain Sesame Flatbread / Vegetable Dim Sum
Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (4g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Wheat flour / All-purpose flour, Fine shredded cabbage, Bell peppers, Sweet corn, Sesame seeds, Sesame oil, Light soy sauce (gluten-free/Jain certified), Star anise, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté shredded cabbage, bell peppers, and corn with light soy sauce, sesame oil, and star anise powder (no onion, garlic, or mushroom). 2. Stuff inside thin dough wrappers, fold into pleated dumplings, and steam for 10 minutes until translucent.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (4g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (3g), Sodium, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Jasmine rice, Vegetable stock, Ginger juliennes, Diced sweet corn, Shredded cabbage, Sesame oil, Soy sauce, White pepper, Crispy fried wonton strips
Recipe Instructions: 1. Simmer jasmine rice in vegetable stock (1:8 ratio) for 1 hour until grains break down into a thick, silky porridge. 2. Stir in ginger juliennes, corn, and cabbage; cook for 10 minutes. 3. Season with light soy sauce, white pepper, sesame oil, and top with wonton strips.

Dish Name: Dim Sum Pork Bao (Char Siu Bao)
Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (2g), Vitamin B1, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Low-gluten bao flour, Yeast, Sugar, Pork shoulder (Char Siu), Hoisin sauce, Oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, Soy sauce, Five-spice powder, Sesame oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dice pre-cooked roast pork and simmer in hoisin, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, and five-spice paste till thick. 2. Prepare sweet leavened yeast dough, flatten discs, and stuff with pork filling. 3. Pleat seal on top and steam in bamboo steamers for 12-15 minutes until white and fluffy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (22g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Soft / Medium Silken Tofu, Doubanjiang (Sichuan fermented broad bean paste), Sichuan peppercorns, Minced shiitake mushrooms, Garlic, Ginger, Soy sauce, Chili oil, Cornstarch, Scallions
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté minced shiitake mushrooms with doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, and chilli oil until fragrant. 2. Add vegetable broth, soy sauce, and cubed silken tofu; simmer gently for 5 minutes. 3. Thicken with cornstarch slurry and finish with freshly crushed Sichuan peppercorns and scallions.

Dish Name: Jain Vegetable Fried Rice & Chilli Tofu
Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (56g), Fiber (5g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Cooked Jasmine / Basmati rice, Cubed Tofu, Bell peppers, Sweet corn, Shredded cabbage, Light soy sauce, Star anise, Sesame oil, White pepper, Cornstarch, Green chillies
Recipe Instructions: 1. High-heat stir-fry cooked rice with bell peppers, corn, cabbage, light soy sauce, white pepper, and sesame oil (no onion/garlic). 2. Crispy fry cornstarch-coated tofu cubes. 3. Toss tofu in a wok with green chillies, bell peppers, soy sauce, and star anise powder.

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Wheat noodles, Minced soy protein / TVP, Chinese sesame paste (Zhi Ma Jiang), Chilli oil, Soy sauce, Sichuan peppercorn powder, Sui Mi Ya Cai (Sichuan preserved mustard greens), Bok choy
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté minced soy protein with preserved mustard greens and soy sauce until crispy brown. 2. Mix sesame paste, chilli oil, soy sauce, and Sichuan pepper into bowl bases. 3. Boil wheat noodles and bok choy, drain, place over sauce base, and top with crispy soy mince.

Dish Name: Kung Pao Chicken (Gong Bao Ji Ding)
Key Nutrients: Protein (34g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (4g), Niacin, Selenium
Ingredients Required: Diced Chicken breast, Roasted peanuts, Dried whole red chillies, Sichuan peppercorns, Leeks/Scallions, Garlic, Ginger, Soy sauce, Chinkiang black vinegar, Shaoxing wine, Cornstarch
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce and Shaoxing wine; velvet in hot oil. 2. Stir-fry dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns till fragrant; add garlic, ginger, leeks, and chicken. 3. Pour sauce made of black vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and cornstarch, toss in crunchy roasted peanuts.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (4g), Vitamin A, Sodium
Ingredients Required: Spring roll pastry sheets, Shredded cabbage, Carrots, Glass noodles, Bean sprouts, Soy sauce, Sesame oil, White pepper, Garlic, Oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté shredded vegetables and glass noodles with soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper until dry. 2. Place filling on pastry sheets, roll tightly, and seal edges with flour slurry. 3. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and super crispy. Serve with sweet chilli sauce.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (3g), Iron
Ingredients Required: Square wonton wrappers, Finely chopped bell peppers, Sweet corn, Shredded cabbage, Sesame oil, Light soy sauce, White pepper, Oil for deep frying / steaming
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté bell peppers, corn, and cabbage with light soy sauce and white pepper (no garlic, ginger, or onion). 2. Place filling in wrapper center, fold into triangle, seal tips together. 3. Deep fry till golden or steam for 8 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (11g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (4g), Vit C, Sodium
Ingredients Required: Refined flour, Shredded cabbage, Carrots, Minced garlic, Onions, Paneer (optional), Schezwan sauce, Soy sauce, Vinegar, Spring onions
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roll flour dough into thin discs, stuff with garlic, onion, and vegetable mix, fold into pleated momos, and steam. 2. Sauté minced garlic, Schezwan sauce, soy sauce, and vinegar in a wok. 3. Toss steamed momos in fiery red chilli garlic sauce till coated.

Key Nutrients: Protein (20g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Niacin
Ingredients Required: Dumpling wrappers, Minced chicken, Scallions, Ginger, Soy sauce, Sesame oil, Shaoxing wine, Cabbage, Black vinegar dipping sauce
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix minced chicken with finely chopped cabbage, ginger, scallions, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, and sesame oil. 2. Fill wrappers, seal with crescent pleats. 3. Pan-fry bottoms till golden, add water splash, cover and steam cook till done (potstickers).

Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (65g), Fiber (6g), Sodium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Noodles, Cabbage, Carrots, Bell peppers, Spring onions, Garlic, Ginger, Dark soy sauce, Chilli sauce, Vinegar, Cornstarch, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare vegetable balls with cabbage, carrot, cornstarch, deep fry into crispy Manchurian balls. 2. Sauté ginger, garlic, soy, chilli sauce, and broth; simmer manchurian balls. 3. Stir-fry boiled noodles in a hot wok with shredded veggies, soy sauce, and vinegar.

Dish Name: Jain Chilli Paneer Gravy with Rice
Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (4g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Paneer cubes, Bell peppers, Green chillies, Cornstarch, Light soy sauce, Tomato ketchup, Vinegar, Star anise powder, White pepper, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Coat paneer cubes in cornstarch slurry and shallow fry until light golden. 2. In a wok, toss green chillies and diced bell peppers (no onion or garlic). 3. Add soy sauce, tomato ketchup, vinegar, star anise powder, water, and cornstarch slurry. Add paneer and simmer.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (46g), Fiber (5g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Extra firm Tofu, Cornstarch, Soy sauce, Hoisi sauce, Rice vinegar, Sesame oil, Dried red chillies, Garlic, Ginger, Broccoli florets
Recipe Instructions: 1. Press tofu, cube, toss in cornstarch, and bake or deep fry till extra crispy. 2. Whisk soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, cornstarch, and water. 3. Sauté garlic, ginger, dried chillies, pour sauce, toss crispy tofu and steamed broccoli until glazed.

Key Nutrients: Protein (38g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (35g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Selenium
Ingredients Required: Whole Duck, Maltose syrup / Honey, Five-spice powder, Mandarin pancakes, Cucumber juliennes, Scallions, Sweet bean sauce (Tianmianjiang) / Hoisin sauce
Recipe Instructions: 1. Blanch duck, glaze skin with maltose syrup and five-spice; air-dry overnight. 2. Roast in oven at high temperature until skin is dark mahogany brown and ultra-crispy. 3. Slice crispy skin and tender meat; serve wrapped in warm Mandarin pancakes with cucumber, scallions, and sweet bean sauce.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (3g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Glutinous rice flour, Brown sugar / Slab sugar, Sweet red bean paste (Azuki), White sesame seeds, Oil for deep frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dissolve brown sugar in hot water, knead into glutinous rice flour to form smooth dough. 2. Stuff dough balls with sweet red bean paste, roll tightly. 3. Dampen balls with water, coat generously in white sesame seeds, and deep fry over medium-low heat while pressing gently until expanded, hollow, and golden brown.

Key Nutrients: Protein (2g), Fat (6g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (2g), Vitamin A, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Ripe Alphonso/Honey mangoes, Small Tapioca pearls (Sago), Coconut milk, Evaporated coconut milk, Sugar, Fresh pomelo / Grapefruit sacs
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil small tapioca pearls until transparent, drain, and plunge into ice water. 2. Puree ripe mangoes with coconut milk and sugar until smooth. 3. Combine chilled mango puree, tapioca pearls, diced fresh mangoes, and top with pomelo sacs.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (4g), Iron
Ingredients Required: All-purpose flour, Water, Sweetened Red Bean paste (or Jujube date paste), Sesame seeds, Ghee / Oil for pan-frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead flour and warm water into soft dough; roll out thin rectangular sheets. 2. Spread red bean paste evenly over half sheet, fold, seal edges, and coat exterior with sesame seeds. 3. Pan-fry in oil/ghee on medium heat until golden brown and flaky.

Key Nutrients: Protein (3g), Fat (4g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (1g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Almond milk, Soy milk, Agar-agar powder (E406), Sugar, Almond extract, Canned mandarin oranges, Maraschino cherries, Sugar syrup
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dissolve agar-agar powder and sugar in boiling almond milk and soy milk. 2. Stir in almond extract, pour into a shallow dish, and chill in refrigerator until firm set. 3. Cut jelly into diamond cubes, serve chilled submerged in light sugar syrup garnished with mandarin oranges and cherries.
